response.sql: WITH totals AS (SELECT link_to_budget, SUM(cost) AS total, COUNT(*) AS n FROM expense WHERE link_to_budget IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_budget), avg_all AS (SELECT AVG(total) AS a FROM totals) SELECT AVG(t.total) AS avg_total, SUM(t.n) AS total_expenses, AVG(t.total - g.a) AS avg_excess FROM totals t, avg_all g WHERE t.total > g.a
